SRC-011:R001.text: STAGE A: smoke sessions never write the repository or user data tree - the smoke harness owns a module-private temp root and DB identity (tests_smoke conftest SmokeEnv boundary)

SRC-011:R002.text: STAGE B: stale and order-dependent smoke tests repaired against current contracts and green in the combined smoke suite

SRC-011:R003.text: STAGE C: T-1201 native Qt lifetime - the formerly crashing combined tests process reaches a normal final summary with exit 0 and no Windows access violation, with root cause classified as harness teardown ownership and the production shutdown drain present

SRC-011:R004.text: STAGE D: the automated release gate is genuinely clean - compileall, ruff, bandit, tests/ and tests_smoke/ all exit 0 in their recorded runs

SRC-011:R005.text: STAGE E: a local acceptance EXE was built from the then-current source with an isolated packaged probe, without being declared a public release

SRC-011:R006.text: STAGE F: the remaining human-only blockers are checkpointed on their owning tickets and the wave stops before publication
